career_ladder.note: Junior Engineers (Electrical and Civil) in Karnataka Power Transmission Corporation Limited (KPTCL) advance through the transmission and grid engineering hierarchy based on departmental tests, service seniority, and performance appraisal.

steps.source_label: KPTCL Employment Notification No. KPTCL/B16/21723/2021-22 and Revised Board Pay Scales
KPTCL Cadre & Recruitment Regulations (In-service quota / promotion)

steps.designation: Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE / Sub-Station & Grid In-charge)
Chief Engineer (CE / Electricity - State Load Despatch Centre / Zonal Grid)

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment comprises a qualifying Kannada Language Test (for non-exempt candidates) followed by an OMR-based competitive Aptitude Test comprising 100 objective questions covering technical diploma engineering curriculum and general aptitude.

stages.source_label: KPTCL Detailed Employment Notification (Kannada Language Test Regulations)

papers.qualifying_threshold: 35% (50 marks out of 150; exempted for candidates who studied Kannada as first or second language in SSLC or higher)

stages.source_label: KPTCL Detailed Employment Notification & Examination Scheme

papers.paper_name: Technical Engineering Diploma Domain (Electrical & Electronics / Civil Engineering Syllabus)
General Aptitude and General Awareness (Logical Reasoning, General Knowledge, Quantitative Aptitude)

stages.source_label: KPTCL Document Verification Notification and Final Merit Selection Lists

papers.paper_name: Verification of Diploma Certificates, Marks Cards, and Category/Reservation Testimonials

financial_package.note: Salary computed as per KPTCL Board Revised Pay Scales (Scale ₹26,270–₹65,020; Entry Basic Pay ₹26,270). In-hand estimate applies mandatory project constant 58% DA as of 2025-07-01 and city-wise HRA (Bengaluru/Zone A at 27%, Class B at 18%, Class C at 9%).
financial_package.pay_source_label: KPTCL Notification No. KPTCL/B16/21723/2021-22 and KPTCL Pay Regulations
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Entry Basic Pay of ₹26,270 at mandatory 58% DA (₹15,237) plus HRA ranging from 9% (₹2,364) in rural grid substations to 27% (₹7,093) in Bengaluru BBMP jurisdiction, less statutory Contributory Pension/NPS (10% Basic+DA), Group Insurance, and professional tax deductions.
official_perks: Medical reimbursement under KPTCL Medical Attendance Regulations
House Rent Allowance (HRA) indexed to posting circle
Electricity consumption concessions as per power utility rules
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) / CPF with matching employer contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment

competition_benchmarks.note: Applicant and vacancy figures verified directly from KPTCL Employment Notifications, Provisional Selection Lists, and Official Cut-off Marks Releases.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 238 (calculated: applicants ÷ total notified vacancies)
years.source_label: KPTCL Notification No. KPTCL/B16/21723/2021-22: 599 total JE posts (JE Electrical: 570 [486 NKK + 84 KK]; JE Civil: 29 [21 NKK + 8 KK]); 1.42 lakh applicants sat for the offline OMR test with cut-offs published January 2024.
